title: Water Cycle Conditions clarity
method: Frozen actual runtime in an owned ephemeral localhost server and isolated Chromium. Native ranges, choices, resets, preset scope, rendered geometry, system colors, shared-model readout agreement, and paused parcel / learner-work preservation. No learner tabs, port 8770, runtime edits, or Git writes.
